Norway.text: At Milano Cortina 2026 it won 18 golds and 41 medals, both records for one Winter Games.
Norway.evidence: The most gold medals won in a single Winter Olympics (18 in 2026) ... The most total medals won in a single Winter Olympics (41 in 2026)

United States.text: It was no Winter power until it hosted the 2002 Games in Salt Lake City.
United States.evidence: In contrast to its summer Olympics status, the United States was not a power in the Winter Games until the 2002 Olympics in Salt Lake City.

Germany.text: After the World Wars it was banned from the 1920, 1924 and 1948 Games.
Germany.evidence: After these wars, Germany was banned from participating in the 1920, 1924, and 1948 Olympics.

Austria.text: No nation has won more Olympic medals in alpine skiing.
Austria.evidence: Austria has won more medals in alpine skiing than any other nation in the world.

Canada.text: At its home Games in Vancouver in 2010, it won the most golds of any nation for the first time.
Canada.evidence: At the 2010 Winter Olympics, Canada would win more gold medals than any other competing nation for the first time. Canada also served as the host nation of the 2010 Winter Olympics, with the games taking place in Vancouver, British Columbia.

Sweden.text: It has never hosted the Winter Games; Stockholm hosted the 1912 Summer Games.
Sweden.evidence: Sweden hosted the Games on one occasion, the 1912 Summer Olympics in Stockholm. ... Swedish athletes have won a total of 514 medals at the Summer Olympic Games, and another 195 at the Winter Olympic Games.

Soviet Union.text: It first entered the Winter Games in 1956, and topped the gold count at seven of its nine.
Soviet Union.evidence: The 1956 Winter Olympics in Cortina d'Ampezzo became the first Winter Olympic Games for Soviet athletes. ... the team was ranked first in the gold medal count seven times and second twice in its nine appearances at the Winter Olympic Games.

Switzerland.text: St. Moritz hosted the Winter Games twice, in 1928 and 1948; the Summer Games have never come to Switzerland.
Switzerland.evidence: Switzerland has hosted the Games on two occasions, both in St. Moritz. The nation has never hosted the Summer Olympics. (Hosted games: 1928, 1948.)

Finland.text: Most of its 181 Winter medals came in Nordic skiing.
Finland.evidence: Finland has also won 181 medals at the Winter Games, mostly in Nordic skiing events.

Italy.text: It has hosted the Winter Games three times: 1956, 2006 and 2026.
Italy.evidence: Italy has hosted a Summer Olympics edition (in 1960) and three Winter Olympics (in 1956, 2006 and 2026).
